verse.verse_1: Nay, I swear by this city -
verse.verse_2: And thou art an indweller of this city -
verse.verse_3: And the begetter and that which he begat,
verse.verse_4: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
verse.verse_5: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
verse.verse_6: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
verse.verse_7: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
verse.verse_8: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
verse.verse_9: And a tongue and two lips,
verse.verse_10: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
verse.verse_11: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
verse.verse_12: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
verse.verse_14: And to feed in the day of hunger.
verse.verse_16: Or some poor wretch in misery,
verse.verse_17: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
verse.verse_18: Their place will be on the right hand.
verse.verse_19: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
verse.verse_20: Fire will be an awning over them.
